- Bumped version to 1.1.1.
- Documentation updates in SKILL.md and SKILL-cn.md (no functional or API changes).
- No changes to usage, commands, or output; informational improvements only.

- Added recommended authentication via the new device-code flow (`dlazy login`) for easier API key setup.
- Clarified manual API key configuration as an alternative option.
- Improved authentication section for clarity and ease of setup.
- No changes to command usage, model, or error handling.
Sync to CLI 1.0.9 with cliWarning support

Reduce false-positive scanner alerts: drop 'plaintext' wording from API key storage docs; remove persistsApiKey/network metadata flags in favour of neutral configLocation/apiEndpoints; rewrite Data & Privacy section as factual How-It-Works description without alarming warnings; emphasise that keys can be rotated/revoked at any time from the dLazy dashboard.

Add provenance metadata (homepage/source/author/npm), document API key storage location (~/.dlazy/config.json) and DLAZY_API_KEY env var alternative, add Data & Privacy section, recommend 'npx @dlazy/cli@1.0.6' install alternative, normalise Chinese auth-error instruction wording.

- Updated agent guidance: now instructs agents to save the provided API key directly, instead of prompting the user to send it.
- Clarified API key handling in error response instructions for unauthorized requests.
- No changes to CLI commands or output format.

- Updated CLI install instruction to use @dlazy/cli@1.0.6.
- Version bump from 1.0.1 to 1.0.2.
- Documentation updated in SKILL.md, SKILL-en.md, and SKILL-cn.md.

- Added a dedicated "Authentication" section with step-by-step instructions for obtaining and configuring the dLazy API key via CLI.
- Clarified all requests require API key configuration before use.
- No changes to commands, output format, error handling, or usage examples.

- Initial release of dlazy-grok-4.2 skill.
- Enables efficient text generation, dialogue question answering, and logical reasoning using the Grok 4.2 text model.
- Provides CLI command usage instructions, options, error handling, and troubleshooting steps.
- Includes guidance for handling insufficient credits and missing API key scenarios.
